title: Mekanism Compat Recipes
description: Currently adds some Crusher recipes for making Bio-Fuel using modded plants and crops
body:
Currently adds biofuel crushing recipes for the following:

Vanilla Items:
- Rotten Flesh

Mods:
  
- Dynamic Trees
- Cobblemon
- Farmers Delight
- Supplementaries

If you find its missing something or would like a mod added, feel free to create an issue.
